fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Dense Vegetation
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the access point at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Keep the full width of the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the residence.
• Create a designated turnaround area near the residence or detached structure so fire and emergency vehicles can reverse direction without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Mark any low-clearance branches along the access drive that may obstruct tall emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can access all sides of that building.
• Keep a clear path along the walkway connecting the residence to the parking and access areas so responders can move on foot without obstruction.
• Post the property address visibly at both the road entrance and near the residence itself so responders can confirm they have reached the correct structure.
• Coordinate with your local fire department to walk the property and identify any staging areas suitable for a second responding unit, given the single access point and limited turnaround space.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Brush Area; Brush Area; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Open Terrain; Single Access Route; Grass Cover; Mixed Vegetation; Woody Debris; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris visible near the structure before fire season.
• Thin scattered trees to create more open space between tree canopy and the roofline.
• Trim shrubs that are close to the structure so bare ground separates them from the exterior walls.
• Cut back mixed vegetation where it grows closest to the structure.
• Mow or cut grass cover around the structure and near the driveway regularly during dry months.
• Clear brush areas closest to the structure, working outward to reduce the amount of plants that could carry fire toward the building.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and low-hanging vegetation so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from within the brush areas nearest to the structure.
